description: Parameters for the NOISE facet post-processing algorithm. Each count is released as a single value from the fixed-width bin of binSize that contains it: the midpoint of the bin plus Laplace noise with scale 1/epsilon, kept within the bin. The noise is drawn deterministically from the cell and the bin, so a repeated request releases the same value. The released value always lies in the count's own bin, so it reveals exactly the bin, the same as ROUNDING with the same binSize.

binSize.description: The width of the bins a count is released from. Must be a positive value.

epsilon.description: Determines the Laplace scale (1/epsilon) of the noise around the midpoint of the bin. Lower values spread the released values more widely within the bin. Must be a positive value.
